title: Sharp Causal Bounds with Confounders Missing Not at Random under Outcome-Independent Missingness
banked_reason: D0.5.G paper_score_ceiling 7.2 is below the 7.4 field threshold; enforced achieved tier subfield, with no bounded in-scope repair.
gap_reasons: The main limitation is scope: exactness relies on categorical U and complete-case overlap, while propensity restrictions, incomplete overlap, and mandatory cellwise missingness can destroy the rectangle and are excluded rather than characterized.

The validation extension identifies only a transported coarse marginal under an explicit law-side transport assumption, and its practical importance is supported by one constructed example rather than a broader design analysis or application.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery completed a closed theorem graph for the exact finite-category allocation fiber, causal witnesses, attained risk rectangle, all continuous contrasts, Peña-bound attainment, target-specific collapse, and a coarse-validation ATE-only example. A post-halt deterministic repair declared two omitted dependency edges, and a fresh independent audit found the graph mathematically sound with no open statements. The result stopped because the general reviewer capped the restricted package at score 7.2/subfield, below the fixed 7.4/field floor; a future re-raise needs genuine scope expansion rather than another repair of the same finite-overlap model.
tldr: Under complete-case overlap, outcome-independent missingness turns the unknown missing-confounder masses into two independent two-moment polytopes. Their exact causal image is the attained rectangle \(\Theta=[L_0,U_0^{\mathrm{up}}]\times[L_1,U_1^{\mathrm{up}}]\), not merely a pair of marginal outer bounds. Every allocation has an explicit NPSEM-IE witness for Peña's Figure-1 graph after reversing his response coding, and when \(a_{edu}>0\) for every \(d,e,u\), every witness also lies in his published joint-cell positivity class. Every continuous real-valued contrast has the exact attained image \([\min_{\Theta}g,\max_{\Theta}g]\); risk difference, risk ratio, odds ratio, and odds difference have corner formulas on their stated real-valued domains. Sparse endpoints, observable feasible-face collapse, exact Peña-attainment criteria, the base-model no-cancellation result, and the separate coarse-validation ATE-only result complete the identification picture without claiming full-law recovery.
gap: Peña analyzes the same binary-exposure, binary-outcome, categorical-confounder graph but explicitly leaves nonsharp risk bounds. Existing categorical compatibility results characterize when some MNAR factual law exists, and rank/completeness results recover the entire law under stronger conditions, but neither resolves the exact causal-risk image or target-specific collapse over a nonunique fiber.
fill: Prove an all-finite-\(K\) compatibility-to-causal witness theorem, the sharp risk rectangle and sparse endpoints, exact Peña-attainment criteria, support-restricted risk-identification tests, and a separately stated coarse-validation theorem with an exact ATE-only example.
